Arab kings: Genghis
Khan, after he saw him,
commanded, and they killed him at a place called Kök Saray,
that is,
the Green Court.
And in the year 611
(611 of the Arabs?) Sultan 'Izz al-Din Kaykawus took possession of Sinope (Sinop?) which is on the shore of the Pontic Sea,
and killed Kir Alex, its lord.
And in the year 612,
a second time.
And in the year 613,
613 of the Arabs, al-Malik al-Zahir Ghazi, son of Salah al-Din Yusuf son of Ayyub, the lord of Aleppo, died;
and he commanded that his young son al-Malik al-'Aziz Muhammad should take his place,
who was then two years and some months old.
For he had another son who was older,
but because the mother of the younger one
was the daughter of al-Malik al-'Adil,
for this reason he appointed him,
lest his older brother drive him away {OCR?}.
And al-Zahir appointed as administrator and atabeg to his young son
Shihab al-Din Tughril, a righteous and merciful eunuch.
And in profound goodness and stable peace were the people of Aleppo, by means of his excellent administration.
And all the extortions
that al-Malik al-Zahir had committed during his life,
he returned to their owners after his death.
And in the year one thousand five hundred and twenty-eight,
1528) of the Greeks,
(1217 of our Lord?
which is the year 614,
614 of the Arabs),
the Pope of Rome sent to all the kings of the Franks,
and laid upon them a charge by the decree of God,
that they should gather their forces
and go out to liberate Jerusalem, the holy city, from the hands of the Arabs {OCR?}.
And a multitude of nations gathered,
and they set out for Acre.
And when al-'Adil heard,
he went out in haste from Egypt to Jerusalem.
And the Franks set out from Acre,
and encamped by the water at a place called the Cave of the Robbers.
For al-'Adil wanted to anticipate them
and encamp there.
And when he was unable,
he encamped at Baysan.
And the Franks approached to engage him.
He, however, because he saw that he did not have the strength of the Franks,
went and encamped in the vicinity of Damascus,
until the gathering should be complete.
And the Franks came and plundered everything they found
from Baysan to Banias,
and they killed and took captive,
and returned to the plain of Acre.
notes: [Variant: In] 610 he also took Antalya (Attalia, Satalia?) from the Romans.
